decisions.headline: 《METAL SLUG Ultimate Collection》公布，收录10款系列作品与未正式发行街机测试版
decisions.summary: Xbox Wire公布《METAL SLUG Ultimate Collection》，合集将收录系列30年历史中的10款作品，其中包括从未正式发行、仅用于街机公开测试的版本，并加入倒带、快速存读档等辅助功能。
decisions.verification: Xbox Wire一手页面已打开，合集数量、未发行测试版与新增辅助功能均由正文明确说明。
decisions.reason: 达到“可以，但不是必须”及以上阈值，且一手证据完整。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.reason: 每周Xbox发售清单主要承担日历发现功能，不作为独立新闻补录；具体游戏日期由发售日历处理。
官方播客为近期公告与新作游玩汇总，本条未提供足够独立新增事实达到单独成稿门槛。
Share of the Week为社区截图精选栏目，不属于本日报需要回填的新闻事实。

decisions.headline: 《ほの暮しの庭》：首轮免费更新定于9月29日推出
decisions.summary: 据電ファミニコゲーマー报道，日本一软件公布了《ほの暮しの庭》的追加内容计划。9月29日的首轮免费更新将加入家具与家畜种类，并提供家具目录和农地扩展功能；第二轮免费更新计划10月27日推出，付费DLC计划于2027年春陆续发布。
decisions.verification: 已审阅不可变证据包中的媒体正文；保留媒体归属，不标为一手官方消息。
decisions.reason: 主体与所述事实可由包内已打开正文核验。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间换算为北京时间，位于原期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《がんばれ！チアリズム》公布首批作曲阵容，菊田裕树、金田充弘等参与
decisions.summary: 《がんばれ！チアリズム》公布首批乐曲创作者，名单包括菊田裕树、金田充弘、工藤吉三、小林早织、增子津可灿、ヒゲドライバー等，多位作曲家将为游戏创作新曲。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer与電ファミニコゲーマー两家独立媒体均已打开并确认首批作曲阵容；后者正文同时包含项目发布信息。
decisions.reason: 达到“可以，但不是必须”及以上阈值，并有两家独立来源交叉确认。
decisions.timeNote: 采用具明确时间戳的電ファミニコゲーマー发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.headline: 《英灵神殿》：日媒报道正式版Metacritic均分达90分
decisions.summary: 据電ファミニコゲーマー9月12日报道，《英灵神殿》正式版在其统计时的Metacritic均分为90/100，共收录16篇媒体评测。报道指出，多家评测肯定了建造、战斗与长期探索体验。该分数是报道时点的快照，不能视为持续更新的实时评分。

decisions.headline: 多重人格蜘蛛少女恋爱ADV《クレアラ・セレクト》公布，计划2027年登陆Steam
decisions.summary: 开发者ナツミカン公布《クレアラ・セレクト》。玩家将在7天内调查拥有8种人格、以少女外形出现的怪异“クレアラ”，通过对话、物资与压力管理逐步解锁人格信息；游戏计划2027年登陆PC（Steam）。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并记录开发者公告、Steam页面、2027年计划与核心调查机制。

decisions.titleEn: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition
decisions.headline: 《Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition》公布Switch 2版，计划2027年推出
decisions.summary: Deep Silver公布《Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition》的Nintendo Switch 2版本，计划2027年发售。Royal Edition包含游戏本体、三项故事扩展、限定装备与额外任务线。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并转述Deep Silver对Switch 2版本、2027年发行计划及Royal Edition内容的公告。

decisions.headline: 最多8人3D绘画派对游戏《SUPER GAHAKU》公布，计划10至11月登陆Steam

decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并记录开发者公开Steam页面、最多8人玩法和预计发行窗口。

decisions.headline: 父女末日生存冒险《Camp Dawn》公布，将登陆Steam
decisions.summary: 韩国独立团队Zero1Play公布《Camp Dawn》。玩家将扮演父亲James，在僵尸末日中驾驶露营车保护5岁女儿Lily、搜集资源并做出影响旅程结局的选择，游戏面向PC（Steam）开发。

decisions.headline: 《歌マクロス》买断版复活众筹启动，不到一天突破7000万日元
decisions.summary: AUGUST于9月10日启动《歌マクロス》买断版复活项目众筹，约1小时突破3000万日元目标；截至报道时支援额已超过7000万日元。买断版计划重构原手游系统、取消体力和付费抽卡，并收录约50首歌曲。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Valheim earns strong launch reviews

entries.headline: ほの暮しの庭: First free update planned for September 29
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reports that Nippon Ichi Software has announced additional content for ほの暮しの庭. The first free update is planned for September 29, adding furniture and livestock varieties, a furniture catalog and farmland expansion. A second free update is planned for October 27, followed by paid DLC in spring 2027.
entries.verification: Reviewed the media text in the immutable evidence packet; this remains an attributed media report.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time within the original fixed window.

entries.headline: Valheim: Japanese report puts launch Metacritic average at 90
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reported on September 12 that Valheim had a Metacritic average of 90/100 across 16 reviews at the time of reporting. The article highlighted praise for building, combat and long-term exploration. These figures are a reported snapshot, not a live score.
entries.verification: Reviewed the media text in the immutable evidence packet; this remains an attributed media report.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time within the original fixed window.

entries.headline: Marvel's Wolverine: Review roundup praises characterization but questions repetitive combat
entries.summary: PC Gamer's review roundup presents mixed reactions to Marvel's Wolverine. Some reviewers praised characterization, the personal story and action, while others criticized repetitive combat and thin level design. This item summarizes that roundup; it is not an original review or an aggregate score.
entries.verification: Reviewed the media text in the immutable evidence packet; this remains an attributed media report.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time within the original fixed window.

entries.headline: UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes: New character arrives September 16, with Switch following September 24
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the additional character ゾハル is planned for September 16 on PS4, PS5 and Steam, followed by Nintendo Switch on September 24. The report describes a fast close-range fighter who combines attacks with a doppelganger. The platform-specific release dates differ.
entries.verification: Reviewed the media text in the immutable evidence packet; this remains an attributed media report.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Beijing time within the original fixed window.

entries.headline: METAL SLUG Ultimate Collection announced with 10 titles and an unreleased arcade test build
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announced a 30th-anniversary METAL SLUG collection containing 10 titles, including a previously unreleased arcade location-test build, plus rewind and quick save/load support.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire page is primary evidence for the collection contents and features.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: CHEEKY CHEERHYTHM reveals its first composer lineup
entries.summary: The first composer lineup includes Hiroki Kikuta, Mitsuhiro Kaneda, Yoshimi Kudo, Saori Kobayashi, Tsukasa Masuko and others, with new music being written for the game.
entries.verification: Two independent opened Japanese outlets confirm the lineup.
entries.timeNote: The timestamped source falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Creara Select announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: The dialogue-driven adventure follows a seven-day investigation of Creara, a spider-like anomaly with eight personalities, and is planned for PC via Steam in 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records the developer announcement and Steam page.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition announced for Switch 2 in 2027
entries.summary: Deep Silver announced a Nintendo Switch 2 version of Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition for 2027, bundling the base game, three story expansions and additional content.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays Deep Silver's announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: SUPER GAHAKU announced for Steam
entries.summary: North Fox Games opened the Steam page for SUPER GAHAKU, a 3D drawing party game for up to eight players planned for around October to November 2026.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records the Steam-page announcement and player count.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Camp Dawn announced for PC
entries.summary: Zero1Play announced Camp Dawn, a zombie-survival adventure about a father protecting his five-year-old daughter while traveling by camper van.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records the official announcement and core premise.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics launches on Steam
entries.summary: Blindspot Games released the 1v1 turn-based arena tactics game Infinity: HexaDome Tactics on Steam on September 11.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the release and game format.
entries.timeNote: The packet places the event inside the fixed window; no precise time is inferred.

entries.headline: Living on Plain Pasta launches on PC
entries.summary: Granité Works released the short-form adventure Living on Plain Pasta on September 10.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the release and premise.
entries.timeNote: The packet places the event inside the fixed window; no precise time is inferred.

entries.headline: Dumb Ways to Build launches
entries.summary: Dumb Ways to Build launched on September 10 as a physics-driven co-op construction game for up to four players.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the release and four-player co-op concept.
entries.timeNote: The packet places the event inside the fixed window; no precise time is inferred.

entries.headline: Hazard Pay launches
entries.summary: Numskull Games released Smitner Studio's block-pushing puzzle game Hazard Pay on September 10.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the release and core puzzle premise.
entries.timeNote: The packet places the event inside the fixed window; no precise time is inferred.

entries.headline: Uta Macross revival crowdfunding passes 70 million yen in under a day
entries.summary: The buy-to-play Uta Macross revival campaign passed its 30 million yen target in about an hour and exceeded 70 million yen by the time of the report.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records the campaign timing, funding totals and revival plan.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.summary: Independent developer Tomozovu-P released a free browser game that retells Run, Melos! as a drive to reach the execution ground before sunset.
